propositions: Core commands across ticket, store, read/write, config, import/export, maintenance, and gate families currently parse argv imperatively; migrating them to shared S2a argparse factories eliminates duplicate grammar definitions

Per-command parser factories must be wired onto Route.parser_factory in _registry.py and invoked from _dispatch_* handlers, while preserving existing command-specific diagnostics, exit codes, and per-family unknown-token semantics (skip vs reject-exit-2)
Router-level global flag extraction (--output, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern) remains layered in _cli/__init__.py before per-command factories see argv; no factory re-declares global flags

Each migrated parser family must preserve its pre-migration unknown-token behavior through negative tests, and execution must resolve only the selected parser factory and handler without importing domain executors or optional dependencies

All 49 core command runtimes must route through their S2a parser factory via Route.parser_factory wiring, with metrics excluded (already migrated in S2c), verified through production-path subprocess and interface tests showing no unapproved behavior deltas
